issues.title: Zambian cops storm Malawi to recover 20 stolen cows
issues.title_en: Zambian cops storm Malawi to recover 20 stolen cows
issues.summary: A dramatic cross-border operation saw Zambian police storm into Malawi last week, hunting down a gang accused of rustling 20 cattle from a farmer’s kraal — in a heist that left the victim counting devastating losses worth 116,500 Zambian Kwacha.
